transcript.revision_rule: Any byte or punctuation change requires a new protocol version; prior results cannot be relabeled.

runs.process_rule: Start every model campaign in a fresh app process and construct a new OfflineTts.
runs.cold_definition: The first synthesis after the fresh app process starts and its OfflineTts is newly constructed; filesystem page caches are not cleared.
runs.warm_definition: Every subsequent synthesis in that same process using the same OfflineTts.
runs.timing_boundary: CLOCK_MONOTONIC around only the synthesis API call. Stop timing before WAV writing, hashing, host validation, playback, or listening.
runs.rtf_definition: For each run, measured synthesis_wall_seconds / measured native_audio_duration_seconds.
runs.warm_median_rtf: Median of all valid measured canonical warm-run RTF values; unavailable if fewer than three valid warm runs.
runs.callback: Record elapsed time to the first non-empty audio callback from synthesis start. Do not play callback audio. If no non-empty callback is observed, record null plus an explicit unavailable reason.

two_thread_follow_up.trigger: Only a successful canonical model with a valid one-thread warm_median_rtf > 1.0.
two_thread_follow_up.reporting: Bounded to one campaign and reported separately; never replace canonical one-thread results.

memory.limitation: VmHWM is the cumulative process-lifetime resident high-water mark, not an independent per-phase peak. Missing access or samples must be unavailable with a reason and must not be estimated.

thermal.baseline: Establish an eligible campaign baseline before the first model; apply the absolute threshold before baseline and both thresholds afterward.
thermal.timeout_outcome: Record thermally_blocked and do not synthesize under materially different conditions.
thermal.bias_reporting: Retain every poll and wait and disclose possible fixed-order thermal bias.

audio_validation: After timing, independently decode the entire native PCM WAV on the host; verify frame count, rate, duration, non-silence, clipping, truncation, and non-finite samples. Record listening separately as performed, failed, or not_performed.
failure_continuation: Serialize each outcome, including host-generated crash/OOM/timeout manifests when the app cannot write one, then continue to the next candidate in fixed order. Never estimate a missing metric.
